title: Karaokio Exchange
description:
I didn't get very far on this Hackathon Project.
I really only got as far as updating the Audius Client w/ a new tab for Artist NFTs.
---

The Karaokio Exchange enables users to:
* Submit requests for new karaoke video files
* Fulfill requests for lyric text files (.cdg)
* Fulfill requests for instrumental track files (.mp3)
* Fulfill requests for video files (.mp4)
* Maintain playlist of all their favorite karaoke songs

See here: https://www.karaokio.com/ for some more demo videos of related projects; I've been a little dormant for the past couple years due to other full-time employment.
how_its_made:
At the time of writing I have a basic Flask App running on Heroku that converts cdg.zip files to mp4 video files using ffmpeg using AWS S3 for storage. 



I also have a proof-of-concept AWS Sumerian 3D/VR Room that plays karaoke youtube videos. 

 * https://ac8951b3633b4d1aa0007e146019b67b.us-east-2.sumerian.aws/?



I'd like to upgrade this app to use Web3 and IPFS making it more of a dApp.
